```{python}
# Imports
from utils import *
from eeg_qc import compute_eeg_pipeline, test_eeg_pipeline
from ecg_qc import ecg_qc 
from eda_qc import eda_qc
from rsp_qc import *
from mic_qc import *
from lsl_problem import *
from et_qc import *
from webcam_qc import *
from behavior_qc import *
from generate_csv import *
from IPython.display import Markdown



subject = "P5943825"
xdf_filename = f'/Users/bryan.gonzalez/CUNY_subs/sub-{subject}/sub-{subject}_ses-S001_task-CUNY_run-001_mobi.xdf'

stim_df = import_stim_data(xdf_filename)
error_log = []

behavior_vars, behavior_error = behavior_qc(xdf_filename, stim_df)
if behavior_error and 'Offset_Experiment' in behavior_vars['missing_stimulus_markers']:
    behavior_print = {'Missing data error': f"Missing stimulus markers including Offset_Experiment for participant {subject} in {xdf_filename}.", 
                      'Missing stimulus markers': behavior_vars['missing_stimulus_markers']}
    error_log.append(behavior_print['Missing data error'])

# if missing stim markers but not missing Offset Experiment
elif behavior_error:
    behavior_print = {'Missing data error': f"Missing stimulus markers for participant {subject} in {xdf_filename}.", 
                      'Missing stimulus markers': behavior_vars['missing_stimulus_markers']}
    error_log.append(behavior_print['Missing data error'])
else:
    behavior_print = {
        "Missing stimulus marker": behavior_vars['missing_stimulus_markers'],
        "Duration of experiment": behavior_vars['total_duration'],
        "Durations do not match expected length": behavior_vars['unexpected_durations'],
        "Duration of impedence check": behavior_vars['impedance_check_duration'],
        "Are all 10 seconds rest equal?": behavior_vars['ten_seconds_rest'],
        "Average response time across all story listening task": behavior_vars['average_response_time']
    }

#Compute the eeg vars
eeg_vars, eeg_df, eeg_error = compute_eeg_pipeline(xdf_filename, 
                                                          stim_df=stim_df, 
                                                          task='RestingState')


if eeg_error:
    eeg_print = f"No EEG data was found for participant {subject} in {xdf_filename}."
    error_log.append(eeg_print)
else:
    eeg_print = {
        "Event": f'{eeg_vars["event"]}',
        "Bad channels before robust reference": eeg_vars["bad_channels_before"], 
        "Interpolated channels": eeg_vars["interpolated_channels"], 
        "Bad channels after interpolation": eeg_vars["bad_channels_after"], 
        "Percent Good before artifact removal": f'{eeg_vars["percent_good"]:.4}%',
        "Artifactual Components Excluded": f'{eeg_vars["excluded_components"]}'
    }

[ecg_vars, ps_df, ecg_error] = ecg_qc(xdf_filename = xdf_filename, stim_df = stim_df, task='RestingState')

if ecg_error:
    ecg_print = f"No ECG data was found for participant {subject} in {xdf_filename}."
    error_log.append(ecg_print)
else:
    ecg_print = {
        "Event": f'{ecg_vars["event"]}',
        "Effective sampling rate": f'{ecg_vars["sampling_rate"]:.4f} Hz', 
        "Percent of data missing": f'{ecg_vars["percent_missing"]:.4}%',
        "Signal to Noise Ratio": f'{ecg_vars["SNR"]:.4f} dB',
        "Average heart rate": f'{ecg_vars["average_heart_rate"]:.4f} bpm',
        "Kurtosis signal quality index (kSQI)": f'{ecg_vars["kurtosis_SQI"]:.4f}',
        "Power spectrum distribution (pSQI)": f'{ecg_vars["power_spectrum_distribution_SQI"]:.4f} mV²/Hz',
        "Relative power in baseline (basSQI)": f'{ecg_vars["relative_baseline_power_sqi"]:.4f}%'
}


if ecg_error:
    ecg_print = f"No ECG data was found for participant {subject} in {xdf_filename}."
    error_log.append(ecg_print)
else:
    ecg_print = {
        "Event": f'{ecg_vars["event"]}',
        "Effective sampling rate": f'{ecg_vars["sampling_rate"]:.4f} Hz', 
        "Percent of data missing": f'{ecg_vars["percent_missing"]:.4}%',
        "Signal to Noise Ratio": f'{ecg_vars["SNR"]:.4f} dB',
        "Average heart rate": f'{ecg_vars["average_heart_rate"]:.4f} bpm',
        "Kurtosis signal quality index (kSQI)": f'{ecg_vars["kurtosis_SQI"]:.4f}',
        "Power spectrum distribution (pSQI)": f'{ecg_vars["power_spectrum_distribution_SQI"]:.4f} mV²/Hz',
        "Relative power in baseline (basSQI)": f'{ecg_vars["relative_baseline_power_sqi"]:.4f}%'
}

if eda_error:
    eda_print = f"No EDA data was found for participant {subject} in {xdf_filename}."
    error_log.append(eda_print)
else:
    eda_print = {
        "Event": f'{eda_vars["event"]}',
        "Effective sampling rate": f'{eda_vars["sampling_rate"]:.4f} Hz', 
        "Percent of data missing": f'{eda_vars["percent_missing"]:.4}%',
        "Signal to noise ratio": f'{eda_vars["snr"]:.4f} dB',
        "Signal integrity check": f'{eda_vars["signal_integrity_check"]:.4f}%',
        "Average skin conductance level": f'{eda_vars["average_scl"]:.4f} mS',
        "Skin conductance level std": f'{eda_vars["scl_sd"]:.4f} mS',
        "Skin conductance level coefficient of variation": f'{eda_vars["scl_cv"]:.4f}%',
        "Average amplitude of skin conductance response": f'{eda_vars["average_scr_amplitude"]:.4f} mS',
        "Skin conductance response validity": f'{eda_vars["scr_validity"]:.4f}%'
    }

rsp_vars, ps_df, rsp_error = rsp_qc(xdf_filename=xdf_filename, stim_df=stim_df, task='RestingState')



Markdown(f"## Quality Report for subject {subject}")
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import base64
from io import BytesIO

# Create a figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot([0, 1, 2], [0, 1, 0])

# Save figure to buffer in memory (not to disk)
buf = BytesIO()
fig.savefig(buf, format="png")
buf.seek(0)
encoded = base64.b64encode(buf.read()).decode("utf-8")

# Create an HTML <img> tag
img_tag = f'<img src="data:image/png;base64,{encoded}" width="200"/>'

# Print table in Markdown with inline figure
from IPython.display import display, Markdown
display(Markdown(f"""
| Column 1 | Column 2 |
|----------|----------|
| Some text | {img_tag} |
"""))

```
